title: Unit Event — Perspective for Smile — Episode1 The Troupe Leader Appears!

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has finished training with Shunmeiza, and is set to study stage combat with the Mikazukigumi troupe. How will Emu and the others fare on this new, intensely physical stage?!

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Everyooone!
Morni-morni-good morning!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make this another wonderhoy day!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seriously, how it is possible for anyone to have so much energy in the morning...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Good morning, Emu.
Sounds like you're in an excellent mood again today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course I am! Because today...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We get to start working with a new group!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's right...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't contain myself regarding the prospect of stepping onto a new stage! It even took me ten whole minutes to fall asleep last night...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds like a normal amount of time...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. In any case, I think it's safe to say that we're all excited about this opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Having to say goodbye to everybody from Shunmeiza was kinda sad...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I'm also really happy we got to learn so much from them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me as well. On top of having the privilege of performing in one of their plays, we were fortunate enough to help make a film. Both invaluable experiences by all accounts...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And they gave us such a nice send-off.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you very much for having us!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you for joining us.
But it's sad to see you all have to go like this...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: However, despite your short stay with us, you showed a tremendous amount of growth.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: You in particular, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
You still have a lot to learn...
But your talent for truly becoming a character is unquestionable.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: That will surely come in handy moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
For now, farewell.
We'll be looking forward to seeing you all on stage again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and we can't thank you enough for everything!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They were all such wonderful people...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm glad that we got to talk to Bakuno one last time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was nice of him to say that he hoped we'd get to perform together again someday.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That means we're all gonna have to get a lot better...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed! We'll need to learn as much as we can as we start working with Mikazukigumi today!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That means I also have to do my best...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I have to learn as much as I can about acting and how troupes work and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (To make everyone in Phoenix Wonderland smile... To make everyone around the world smile!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I have no idea what working with Mikazukigumi is going to involve...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're known for putting on incredibly entertaining performances that are historical in nature.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They're particularly good at performing stunts and doing sword fights, so their practices may be very demanding physically.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yikes, you're right...
I'm gonna have to do my best to keep up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: On the other hand, this is a golden opportunity for us to learn how to do stunts and sword fights!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I had a chance to learn a little during a workshop a long time ago, so I'm very much looking forward to this!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, me too! I wanna go all, “Shing!” and, “Hiyah!” and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I heard that the current leader of Mikazukigumi founded this troupe when he was still a university student!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I really wanna hear about how he actually founded this troupe and how he runs it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent!
After all, acting is only a part of our training!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to meet him...

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? What was that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Look, over there...!
That delivery person on that hill...!

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line: Th-The dolly's getting away...!
se_event_smile_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line:
What if it hits someone?!
Also, the packages are gonna get damaged!
se_event_smile_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Th-This is bad...!
We need to stop it!
Leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
*Shout*
*Roar*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa...
He stopped the dolly. But it was going so fast...!
Phew. Okay, it's stopped...

rows.Speaker: Delivery Person
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
You're a lifesaver!

No, that's okay!
It was nothing.
I was just putting my muscles to good use!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No ordinary person would be able to do what he just did...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
He's got an odd personality too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But he seems really familiar...
Anyway, farewell! I have to be somewhere!
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, he's coming this way!
You guys are Wonderlands×Showtime, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we are. Does that mean you're...?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
I'm Daigo Kijima!
Leader of the Mikazukigumi troupe!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...!
We weren't expecting the troupe leader to come and meet with us first...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Please pardon us!
My name is Tsukasa Tenma. Thank you very much for allowing us to work with your troupe so suddenly!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! There's no need to be so formal with me.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Shosuke's told me all about how you're going around to train with different troupes.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! You know Shosuke?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Hm? He didn't tell you?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: He and I attended the same university. We were studying different things, but met during this one class we both happened to be taking freshman year.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when he came over and asked for my help. He said, “I need you to lend some people I know a hand. I beg you.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... We look forward to working with you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We want to learn as much as we possibly can to make our dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We may end up causing you some trouble, but we're still going to do our best...!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: I'm not doing this because Shosuke asked me to. I'm doing this as a troupe leader and fellow actor. I'm here to help young talent such as yourselves grow.

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: So, I'm prepared to give you all the support I can!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mr. Kijima...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line: You're welcome! Now, follow me!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kijima
rows.Line:
Time to run after that sun in the sky!
After that, your training with Mikazukigumi will begin!
se_run_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Look how far he's already gone.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, we're going to get left behind...!
We need to start chasing after him...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why is running the first thing we're doing...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Just think of it as a way for us to improve our stamina.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...
Which means our training has already begun! We should expect no less from Mikazukigumi...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: ...do our very best and have a wonderhoy time with our new friends!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, let's!
